t: What Agent Memory Integrity Database Is All About
title: What Agent Memory Integrity Database Is All About
description: Memory integrity keeps agent recall true: context windows (the working memory), vector stores (the long-term), and summaries (the compressed). Threats: prompt injection (the malicious memory), hallucinated recall, stale facts, and cross-session leakage. Guards: source tagging, freshness dating, access controls. The agent's memory is its identity — protect it. This database is the complete memory integrity record: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
